entry.title: Postevand Water Pitcher
entry.summary:
Vendor: Postevand
Type:
Price: 1500.00

The Postevand water pitcher is the first in a series of water carriers we will introduce. Created in collaboration with glass designer Marie Breyen, it is the first physical manifestation in a new collection of objects exploring the essence of water. The pitcher carries the imprint of nature: its form is blown into the bark of a Scots pine, leaving the tree’s texture as a hidden structure within the glass. Technically, the pitcher is crafted from two layers of glass—the first shaped as a bottle, followed by an additional layer blown into the bark mold. The neck is drawn and opened with glass shears.

Marie Breyen is a trained glassblower, graduating from The National School of Glass (Riksglasskolan) in Sweden (2016–2019), where she received a classical, technical education. She later earned a degree from The Royal Danish Academy, Bornholm, in Crafts with a focus on glass and ceramics (2019–2023).

Only eight unique pitchers have been created, each distinct in its own way.

entry.summary:
Vendor: Postevand
Type:
Price: 85.00



In this special release you get to discover the captivating work of Kim Stanley Robinson, an acclaimed American science fiction author. Time Magazine recognized him as a "Hero of the Environment" for his visionary storytelling, ecological consciousness, and future-historical perspectives.

In 2021, Robinson was invited to COP26, where he contributed with the text "Remembering Climate Change - A Message from the Year 2071." This powerful narrative reveals how humanity confronted the climate crisis and took charge of the biosphere. Now, this impactful story is available in Danish translation.

entry.title: Postevand x SIGG Bottle
entry.summary:
Vendor: Postevand
Type:
Price: 149.00

Our reusable bottle is a collaboration with Swiss company SIGG. The bottle is made in Switzerland from one piece of high-quality recycled aluminium sourced in Europe. It is lightweight, durable and free from harmful chemicals including BPA and phthalates. It is made to stay with you for a lifetime and keep you hydrated when you are far away from the tap.

SIGG has been producing high-quality aluminium products since 1908. Since 1993, one of their lightweight and reusable aluminium bottles has been displayed at MoMA in New York.
